_comment: Delivery destinations (web3d/src/deliveries.ts). wall+at+out: a street wall from city.json walls (at = 0..1 along it as in the facade picture, left to right; out = metres in front). x,z: tool frame (z north), y optional floor height. Copied to public/city/ by sync-assets.mjs. Measure `at` on .art/facades/<name>/raw.png.

items.name: Zagrebačka nadbiskupija
items.note: the rear entrance on the palace's east front, outside the Cathedral walls (Google Maps pin of Zagrebačka nadbiskupija); reached through the gate by the south-east tower and up the private road, or through the gate by Domitrovićeva kula and round the north wall. The precinct inside the walls behind the Cathedral is fenced off (data/fences.json).
